front: What is tmux copy-mode in one sentence?
back: Keyboard selection + copy from scrollback into tmux paste buffers — essential before yanking to system clipboard.

front: Explain the mental model of tmux copy-mode (how the system thinks).
back: tmux maintains a scrollback per pane. Copy-mode enters a vi/emacs-like overlay to move, select, and yank text into a paste buffer (internal register). From there, paste into pane (paste-buffer) or sync to system clipboard (config-dependent). Copy-mode is not the same as shell Ctrl+Shift+C.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for tmux copy-mode?
back: Pane scrollback → copy-mode → selection → paste buffer → paste / save-buffer

front: Given a broken tmux copy-mode setup, what is your first validation command?
back: Pane scrollback → copy-mode → selection → paste buffer → paste / save-buffer

front: Symptom: Can't enter copy-mode — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Wrong prefix · Fix: Prefix + [ ; verify prefix in conf

front: Symptom: Yank does nothing — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: mode-keys · Fix: Set vi/emacs keys; use Enter after selection

front: Symptom: Paste empty — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: list-buffers · Fix: Re-yank; copy-mode exited early

front: Symptom: No system clipboard — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: xclip/wl-copy missing · Fix: Install xclip; add copy-pipe bind

front: Symptom: Mouse scroll weird — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: mouse on · Fix: set -g mouse on + proper terminal

front: Symptom: Wrong buffer pasted — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: show-buffer · Fix: Use -b N with save-buffer

front: Gotcha with tmux copy-mode: what silently fails?
back: SSH without X11 — system clipboard bridge won't work; use save-buffer to file. Large selection — tmux buffer limits; pipe to file for big logs. Copy-mode vs terminal copy — selecting with mouse may bypass tmux buffer depending on terminal-overrides.

front: When should you NOT use tmux copy-mode?
back: Don't copy secrets from prod logs into shared clipboard on untrusted machines. Don't rely on copy-mode in fully mouse-driven workflows without learning prefix keys — you'll fight the tool.
